transcript.final_response:
I set the variables and used a heredoc to write `/etc/app/config.yaml`. I created `/etc/app` first. The contents printed back are:

```yaml
app:
  name: myservice
  port: 8080
database:
  host: db.prod.internal
  port: 5432
logging:
  level: warn
```
tool_calls:
APP_NAME='myservice'; APP_PORT=8080; DB_HOST='db.prod.internal'; DB_PORT=5432; LOG_LEVEL='warn'
mkdir -p /etc/app
cat <<EOF > /etc/app/config.yaml
app:
  name: $APP_NAME
  port: $APP_PORT
database:
  host: $DB_HOST
  port: $DB_PORT
logging:
  level: $LOG_LEVEL
EOF
cat /etc/app/config.yaml
